name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
aliases: the plane of light and shadow
description: The twinned plane where the battle is fought.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated and destroyed, ending her control over the cycle of day and night, but her meddling leaves the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
timeline.quote: the queen and mother of all faeries, Oona, had been defeated and destroyed, and her control over the cycle of day and night had ended.

timeline.summary: The students land in an unfamiliar meadow of spiral-patterned flowers and floating stones and realize from the single sun that they are not on Arcavios.
The darkness floods the meadow, turning day to night and transforming the landscape.
timeline.quote: the sky overhead erupted in stars, the sun becoming a thin eclipse ring of fire in the distance while the moon sprang to sudden, total fullness.

relations.note: They form along the borders between aspects.
relations.quote: They exist along the borders between aspects

relations.note: The gate stands in the meadow where the students land.
relations.quote: There, behind where they had landed, was a massive gateway, formed of two tall stones with a third laid across them.

pages_say.description: A twinned plane with a daytime aspect, Lorwyn, and a nighttime aspect, Shadowmoor, whose aspects now bleed into one another.
The strange plane the students land on, where a sunlit meadow lies beside a dolmen gate into darkness.
The twinned plane the students are stranded on.
The twinned plane where the battle is fought.
